name: comphash
algorithm: Stream a mixed binary/text file in 64 KiB chunks while computing SHA-256 and compressing to a zlib stream (RFC 1950, level 6), then read the compressed file back, decompress with header/Adler-32/EOF validation while hashing a second SHA-256, verify length and digest match, and print bytes and hex SHA-256 (README.md).

rust.name: flate2
rust.inside: its default rust_backend: miniz_oxide 0.8.8 and adler2 2.0.0 (pure Rust, forbid(unsafe_code)); crc32fast 1.4.2 (unsafe SIMD for gzip CRC-32, unused by zlib framing)

rust.name: sha2
rust.inside: unsafe Rust and x86 SHA extensions (sha256rnds2) through core::arch, chosen at run time by cpufeatures 0.2.17, with a software fallback; digest 0.10.7, block-buffer 0.10.4, crypto-common 0.1.7, generic-array 0.14.7 and typenum 1.20.0

rust.name: ring
rust.inside: unused by comphash; listed in Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock only because cratespin requires Cargo.lock to match the shared vendored crate tree (dead-code eliminated by LTO)

rust.name: walkdir
rust.inside: unused by comphash; listed in Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock only because cratespin requires Cargo.lock to match the shared vendored crate tree (dead-code eliminated by LTO)

labels.zig: software SHA-256: Zig 0.17 chooses SHA instructions at compile time, and the row's x86-64-v2 target has none (README.md, Hardware paths)

skip.c: no std zlib or SHA-256 in C (no C SHA-256 library is vendored)

notes: Every cell compresses at RFC 1950 zlib level 6 and validates header FCHECK/FDICT, stream termination, and Adler-32 trailer on decompression (Zig checks FCHECK/FDICT and Adler-32 explicitly with std's own flate.Container.Hasher because Zig 0.17 Decompress skips both; C# wraps the input FileStream in StrictEofStream so truncated streams fail instead of returning silent EOF).
output.check is zlib: tools/bench verify independently decompresses each cell's out.zlib with Go's compress/zlib and checks that the decompressed stream's SHA-256 matches the input file.

Rust reuses the already-vendored crates/flate2-1.1.1-ring-0.17.14-sha2-0.10.9-walkdir-2.5.0 tree; ring and walkdir are declared only to keep Cargo.lock in sync with the shared vendor directory and are never imported or called.
The input size (256 MiB) puts the fastest cell (mk) above the 1 s floor.
